prerequisites: Overcoming the evaluations foreseen in the remaining subjects of the study plan and thus having all the necessary credits for obtaining the master's degree, except those corresponding to the thesis itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Know how to individually carry out, present and defend before a university tribunal an original project in the field of Computer Engineering of a professional nature, in which all the acquired competencies are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: Individual development of an original project within the field of Computer Engineering.
Specific contents will be determined by the theme developed in each work.
teaching_methods: Non-contact activities (except evaluation sessions and individual tutor meetings)

assessment_methods.method: Presentation and defense of the TFM report before a university tribunal

assessment_rules: The evaluation will be carried out before a university tribunal through the presentation and defense of the Master's Thesis report. The presentation should not exceed 30 minutes, including a product demonstration if the TFM type requires it. The tribunal will evaluate general presentation, logical structure, author's viewpoints and conclusions, scientific-technical quality, presentation quality, audience engagement, and ability to answer questions. Details of the evaluation are subject to the general regulations of the University of Oviedo and the Gijón School of Engineering.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Informática (Informática, Oviedo)
